q: The Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse A⁺ of a matrix A with SVD A = UΣVᵀ is given by:
opts: A⁺ = Vᵀ Σ⁺ U where Σ⁺ replaces each nonzero σᵢ by 1/σᵢ
A⁺ = (AᵀA)⁻¹Aᵀ when A is full column rank (otherwise undefined)
A⁺ = U Σ⁺ Vᵀ where Σ⁺ replaces each nonzero σᵢ by 1/σᵢ
exp: A⁺ = V Σ⁺ Uᵀ where Σ⁺ inverts each nonzero singular value. This satisfies the four Moore-Penrose conditions: AA⁺A = A, A⁺AA⁺ = A⁺, (AA⁺)* = AA⁺, (A⁺A)* = A⁺A. It gives the minimum-norm least-squares solution to Ax = b.
